item.title: Video: 39 passengers escape after private travel bus catches fire in AP
item.description: Smoke from the rear engine alerted the bus driver, who managed to stop the bus and get the passengers safely out on time, with their luggage at around 6 am, Kanchikacherla police inspector said.

item.title: How do you assess Buy vs Rent decisions in high-inflation times? Sanghvi Realty MD explains
item.description: In periods of high inflation, the buy-versus-rent decision becomes less emotional and far more analytical. Pakshal Sanghvi, MD of Sanghvi Realty explains that rising costs of living, higher interest rates and tighter household budgets mean homeownership must be evaluated as a long-term financial commitment rather than a default life milestone.

item.title: Ritu Tawde of BJP to be new Mumbai mayor, Shiv Sena’s Sanjay Shankar to be deputy mayor
item.description: Ritu Tawde new Mumbai mayor: In the 2025 elections, she was re-elected from Ward Number 132. She has also served as the chairperson of the Education Committee of the Mumbai Municipal Corporation.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Jasprit Bumrah likely to miss India’s opener against USA, Kishan to open – Report
item.description: Pacer Jasprit Bumrah is likely to miss India’s T20 World Cup opening match against the United States of America (USA) on February 7.

item.title: Caught on camera: Two men assaulted by bouncers at Noida mall; seven held
item.description: The clash took place at Impulse bar inside Noida’s Garden Galleria Mall. Footage from the scene shows two men allegedly getting assaulted by bouncers. The footage further shows, three to four bouncers repeatedly kicking and punching the two men during the scuffle. One of the men is seen falling to the ground, but the bouncers continue to assault him even after he is down.

item.title: Smita Mandhana’s savage mom roast on Palash Muchhal steals spotlight after Smriti’s WPL glory | See POST
item.description: Smriti Mandhana’s mom Smita reposted a savage meme roasting ex Palash Muchhal after RCB’s WPL triumph. “Smashing Delhi Capitals like seeing her ex,” it joked. Netizens crowned her “Savage Aunty” before she deleted it. Internet loves the bold family shade amid cricket glory.

item.title: Ramadan meal planning with nourishing suhoor and balanced iftar ideas
item.description: Suhoor and iftar play a vital role in maintaining energy and focus during Ramadan fasting. Here are the healthy suhoor and iftar ideas.

item.title: BCCI announces Rs 7.5 crore prize money for India’s U-19 team after World Cup triumph
item.description: The Board of Control for India (BCCI) announced Rs 7.5 crore prize money for the Under-19 team after they defeated England by 100 runs in the final to secure the U19 World Cup title for the record sixth time on February 6.

item.title: South producer sues Firoz Nadiadwala over Hera Pheri 3 rights in Madras HC
item.description: Hera Pheri 3 hits legal snag as South producer Seven Arts sues Firoz Nadiadwala, claiming exclusive sequel rights from Malayalam originals. Madras HC questions if film is even happening. GP Vijayakumar says, “He can’t sell what he doesn’t own.”

item.title: Inside India AI stack: Five layers driving India’s AI for all vision
item.description: India is building a population-scale artificial intelligence ecosystem through the India AI Stack, focused on making AI accessible, reliable, and citizen-centric. The stack integrates applications, sovereign AI models, affordable compute, digital infrastructure, and clean energy to drive real-world impact across sectors.
